ideas.pitch: An embodied AI agent that accepts natural language task instructions via microphone and translates them into precise multi-axis coordinate trajectories for a desktop robotic arm.
ideas.title: Voice-Controlled Mobile Robotic Arm for Lab Automation
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines an unusual physical build with embodied AI task planning, directly targeting judges in the Hardware & Physical Systems track looking for integrated software-hardware solutions.

ideas.pitch: A camera-equipped conveyor prototype powered by an ESP32-CAM and a local Python classification model that sorts recyclables while detecting hardware jams using sensor telemetry.
ideas.title: Edge-AI Smart Waste Sorter with Local Anomaly Alerting
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly mirrors a proven winner at hardware-focused hackathons by pairing a live physical sorting mechanism with real-time computer vision and operational logging.

ideas.pitch: A real-time 3D simulation dashboard built on Three.js that mirrors and predicts automated guided vehicle paths, optimizing traffic flow in warehouse layouts.
ideas.title: Digital Twin Simulator for Automated AGV Fleet Operations
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the Simulation, Digital Twins & Virtual Robotics track with a working graphical representation that judges can interact with live during the demo.

ideas.pitch: A differential-drive robot equipped with LIDAR and wheel encoders that autonomously maps an unfamiliar room and streams telemetry back to a local dashboard.
ideas.title: Autonomous Indoor Mapping Rover with Sensor Fusion
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates genuinely hard engineering through SLAM algorithms and autonomous navigation running entirely on embedded hardware within a tight hackathon timeframe.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous diagnostic dashboard that ingests live sensor telemetry from an ESP32 micro-climate rig, runs anomaly detection, and proposes automated remediation steps using an LLM agent graph.
ideas.title: Multi-Agent IoT Operations and Diagnostic Copilot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages advanced multi-agent workflows adapted from a proven hackathon winner, providing a polished and comprehensive closed-loop software solution.
